name: set_volume
description: Change the Mac's output volume: mute, unmute, louder, quieter, or max.

args.name: level
args.instructions: How does the user want the system volume changed?

script:
set lvl to "{{level}}"
if lvl is "mute" then
  set volume with output muted
else if lvl is "unmute" then
  set volume without output muted
else if lvl is "max" then
  set volume output volume 100 without output muted
else
  set cur to output volume of (get volume settings)
  if lvl is "louder" then
    set volume output volume (cur + 15) without output muted
  else
    set volume output volume (cur - 15)
  end if
end if
return "volume " & (output volume of (get volume settings))
script_win: $ws = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; switch ("{{level}}") { 'mute' { $ws.SendKeys([char]173) } 'unmute' { $ws.SendKeys([char]173) } 'max' { 1..50 | ForEach-Object { $ws.SendKeys([char]175) } } 'louder' { 1..5 | ForEach-Object { $ws.SendKeys([char]175) } } 'quieter' { 1..5 | ForEach-Object { $ws.SendKeys([char]174) } } }; 'volume changed'

name: open_app
description: Open, launch, or switch to an application and bring its window to the front (Chrome opens a new window in your work profile).

args.name: app
args.instructions: Which application does the user want opened or brought to the front?

script:
if "{{app}}" is "Google Chrome" then
  set homeArg to ""
  if "{{chrome_home}}" is not "" then set homeArg to " " & quoted form of "{{chrome_home}}"
  do shell script "open -na 'Google Chrome' --args " & quoted form of ("--profile-directory=" & "{{chrome_profile}}") & " --new-window" & homeArg
else
  tell application "{{app}}" to activate
end if
repeat 15 times
  delay 0.2
  tell application "System Events" to set frontName to name of first application process whose frontmost is true
  if frontName is "{{app}}" then exit repeat
  try
    tell application "System Events" to set frontmost of process "{{app}}" to true
  end try
end repeat
try
  tell application "{{app}}"
    if (count of windows) = 0 then reopen
  end tell
end try
if frontName is "{{app}}" then return "{{app}} is in front"
return "{{app}} launched, but " & frontName & " is still in front"
not_for: Websites, URLs, web searches, or anything the user says to do 'in the browser' or 'from the browser'; those belong to a browser tool (safari_open / chrome_open).
script_win: $app = "{{app}}"; $chrome = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $chrome)) { $chrome = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe' }; if ($app -eq 'Google Chrome') { if (Test-Path $chrome) { Start-Process $chrome "--profile-directory={{chrome_profile}}" } else { Start-Process 'https://www.google.com' }; "$app opened"; exit 0 }; $menus = @((Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs'), (Join-Path $env:AppData 'Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs')); $lnk = Get-ChildItem $menus -Recurse -Filter *.lnk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.BaseName -eq $app } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $lnk) { $lnk = Get-ChildItem $menus -Recurse -Filter *.lnk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.BaseName -like "$app*" } | Select-Object -First 1 }; if ($lnk) { Start-Process $lnk.FullName; "$app opened"; exit 0 }; $alias = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA ('Microsoft/WindowsApps/' + $app + '.exe'); if (Test-Path $alias) { Start-Process $alias; "$app opened"; exit 0 }; $exe = Get-Command $app -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($exe) { Start-Process $exe.Source; "$app opened"; exit 0 }; Write-Error "$app is not installed."

name: quit_app
description: Quit a running application.

args.name: app
args.instructions: Which running application does the user want to quit?

script_win: $app = "{{app}}"; $names = @(($app -replace '\s', ''), ($app -split '\s+')[-1]); $procs = Get-Process | Where-Object { $names -contains $_.ProcessName }; if (-not $procs) { Write-Error "$app is not running."; exit 1 }; $procs | Stop-Process; "$app closed"

name: take_screenshot
description: Capture the whole screen to a timestamped PNG on the Desktop.
script:
set ts to do shell script "date +%Y-%m-%d_%H.%M.%S"
set p to (POSIX path of (path to desktop)) & "Screenshot_" & ts & ".png"
do shell script "screencapture -x " & quoted form of p
return "saved to Desktop"
script_win: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms,System.Drawing; $b = [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::PrimaryScreen.Bounds; $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $b.Width, $b.Height; $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp); $g.CopyFromScreen($b.Location, [System.Drawing.Point]::Empty, $b.Size); $p = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')) ("Screenshot_" + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH.mm.ss') + ".png"); $bmp.Save($p); "saved to Desktop"

  else if site is "github" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://github.com/search?q=" & enc

  else if site is "x_twitter" then

    end if
  else if site is "notion" then
    set q to "https://www.notion.so"
  else if site is "slack_web" then
    set q to "https://app.slack.com"
  else if site is "figma" then
    set q to "https://www.figma.com"
  else if site is "chatgpt" then
    set q to "https://chatgpt.com"
  else if site is "claude" then
    set q to "https://claude.ai"
  else if site is "reddit" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://www.reddit.com/search/?q=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.reddit.com"
    end if
  else if site is "wikipedia" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.wikipedia.org"
    end if
  else if site is "amazon" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://www.amazon.com/s?k=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.amazon.com"
    end if
  else if site is "netflix" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://www.netflix.com/search?q=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.netflix.com"
    end if
  else if site is "spotify_web" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://open.spotify.com/search/" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://open.spotify.com"
    end if
  else if site is "hacker_news" then
    set q to "https://news.ycombinator.com"
  else if site is "stack_overflow" then

      set q to "https://stackoverflow.com/search?q=" & enc

    end if
  else if site is "hugging_face" then

    else
      set q to "https://huggingface.co"
    end if
  else if site is "linear" then
    set q to "https://linear.app"
  else if site is "vercel" then
    set q to "https://vercel.com"
  else if site is "livekit" then
    set q to "https://docs.livekit.io"
  else if site is "gradium" then
    set q to "https://gradium.ai"
  else if site is "typesafe" then
    set q to "https://typesafe.ai"
  else if site is "outlook" then
    set q to "https://outlook.live.com"

  activate
  if (count of windows) = 0 then make new window

tell application "Spotify" to return (player state as string)

name: spotify_next
description: Skip to the next track in Spotify.
script:
tell application "Spotify"
  next track
  delay 0.5
  return name of current track & " by " & artist of current track
end tell

name: spotify_now_playing
description: Say which track is currently playing in Spotify.
script: tell application "Spotify" to return name of current track & " by " & artist of current track
script_win: $p = Get-Process Spotify -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($p) { $p.MainWindowTitle } else { 'nothing is playing' }

name: terminal_run
description: Type and run a shell command in the front Terminal window (asks for confirmation).

args.name: command
args.instructions: The shell command the user wants run in Terminal.

script:
tell application "Terminal"
  activate
  do script "{{command}}" in front window
end tell
return "ran command"
examples: run git status in the terminal
